dog.description_text:
Sweet senior kitty Kermit has lots of love to give!

Kermit is a gray tabby who is affectionate, calm, and easy to spend time with. He enjoys being petted and is especially fond of cheek scratches, leaning into your hand to absorb them fully! Kermit has lived well with young children and has been comfortable with them petting him. In his previous home he was known as a wonderful and well-behaved cat.

This lovely boy would make an excellent companion for someone looking for a relaxed, friendly cat. Imagine spending your days together with Kermit curled up nearby, keeping you company while you relax, read, or watch your favorite shows. Kermit would love to spend his golden years in a cozy home where he can settle in, enjoy a great napping spot, and spend time with his favorite people.

A cat like Kermit will make your house a home!

To learn more about Kermit, click the “Adopt me” button.

*You can meet animals located at the ASPCA Adoption Center during our walk-in hours (daily, noon to 6 p.m.). We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
